The retained jobs-ON stdout and stderr also match the receipt's 84c9ca03 and 2c8a5325.

- **Frozen contract.** I ran the kit's own frozen_files(root, manifest) on a mode-0400 copy, importing the frozen contract code, and it PASSED. That run covers:
  - measurement_manifest;
  - every file's mode and hash;

It allows only RUNNING_NORMAL, with entryPolicy HEALTHY_RUNNING_NORMAL_ONLY and historicalFailedWalEvidenceOnly true, so the failed-WAL receipt and the held triple are evidence only. The workload pins carry labAndHubBuildsOwnedByYY=true and RELEASE_DAY_DISK_ABORTS_ACCEPTED.
- **The proof.** This is the same single stopped PASSED proof 041721Z (PASSED_NEW_CANDIDATE_NATURAL_KOBO_PROOF), with no proof, build or copy replayed.

Remaining gates, all enforced by the frozen coordinator, collector and launcher; this verdict does not replace any of them:
- one fresh 10-minute single-use gate on this unchanged and unused kit;
- the single reviewed entry state HEALTHY_RUNNING_NORMAL_ONLY. The 4894eabc writer must be running, Docker-healthy and not OOM on the original ingress f46aeaae, rechecked at the gate, at launch and before quiesce. A held, stopped or unhealthy entry refuses.
- main still at 51f67988 with main CI green;
- the PR #293 formal review, with no subsequent negative verdict;
- disk headroom for the six retained allocations plus assets and margin;
- the historical receipt 0b8c3f54 unchanged.

Then ONE forward deploy under YY's standing go:
- held ingress, normal quiesce, stopped hashed backups and WAL-aware full state;
- a jobs-OFF zero-write check before ingress and jobs;
- 768 MiB, with NODE_OPTIONS empty;
- 660 healthy jobs-ON seconds and zero restarts.

The deploy is forward-only: no restore, older image, retry, heap override, cleanup or replay. Other application merges stay held until #293 is live and my post-deploy check passes. Human cards and the four refused configs stay untouched.
